Reincarnation#000.src: Talk to Batelu in Bob's Tomb.

Reincarnation#001.src: Hello adventurer! I see you want to solve the mystery of Bob's tomb also? Glad to meet you.
Reincarnation#001.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#002.src: My name is Batelu. Lately, I've been studying these strange symbols on the walls.
Reincarnation#002.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#003.src: It's about Bob. Hopefully you do not believe the stories of his death, right? Bob couldn't have died so easily. Not to something so mundane as a wolf.
Reincarnation#003.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#004.src: He wasn't only strong, he was absolutely un-killable, a master in almost every skill.
Reincarnation#004.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#005.src: I believe he knew he was about to die. How? What of? Nobody knows, but he left this world prepared.
Reincarnation#005.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#006.src: You see, it says here Bob had three loyal animals. Before dying, he scattered them across the ocean.
Reincarnation#006.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#007.src: I think those animals are the key to accessing his real tomb...
Reincarnation#007.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#008.src: You see that little gap right there? It's the entrance...
Reincarnation#008.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#009.src: Unfortunately, nobody was able to remove the spell blocking it.
Reincarnation#009.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#010.src: But I do. I know how to open the passage to Bob. This is where the animals come in useful...
Reincarnation#010.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#011.src: I believe Bob did something to those animals. I think if we could reunite them in some way, we could open the passage.
Reincarnation#011.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#012.src: Bring me {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool & {~} Mooington's Skin if you can find them.
Reincarnation#012.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#013.src: I am sure that together, we can open the passage. Good luck.
Reincarnation#013.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#014.src: Bring back {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool, and Mooington's Skin to Batelu.

Reincarnation#015.src: Wonderful! We can now open the passage to the true tomb of Bob...
Reincarnation#015.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#016.src: I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, merely read it. You shall go alone, be careful.
Reincarnation#016.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#018.src: I am Bob, master of the arts of Wynn.
Reincarnation#018.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#019.src: Let me explain why you are here.
Reincarnation#019.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#020.src: My animals, were my greatest allies in my travels through the world.
Reincarnation#020.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#021.src: I travelled too far, mined too deep, and of course challenged what should not be challenged. My time in Wynn was coming to an end.
Reincarnation#021.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#022.src: I knew so, too. But I refused to leave without giving the power i had attained to those worthy of it.
Reincarnation#022.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#023.src: Using what ability I had left to me, I transferred my power to my animals, in three pieces. In the hope that those worthy to harness it will seek them out.
Reincarnation#023.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#024.src: The spell I placed on the door to this realm will only break to the one who collects my power. But it cannot have escaped your notice, you do not have my power.
Reincarnation#024.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#025.src: The truth is, you must pass a test, the ultimate test. Hone your skills you have learnt throughout your travels, and face me. Face me, and earn your place amongst soldiers of Wynn.
Reincarnation#025.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#026.src: Bring back {~} Bob's Seal of Approval to Batelu.

Reincarnation#027.src: Ah! You have returned! Tell me, what did you find within?
Reincarnation#027.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#028.src: ...You faced Bob himself in combat? And you triumphed? That's quite remarkable!
Reincarnation#028.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#029.src: And he gave you his Seal of Approval... Hm. If that is the case, then there is something I may do for you.
Reincarnation#029.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#030.src: Before Bob passed, he left his mythical weapons with a trusted friend. They were, so he said, to be kept for one who would be worthy to wield them...
Reincarnation#030.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#031.src: Yes... Yes, I am certain. You have proven yourself worthy. Take this relic, the Stone of Myths, and bring it to the Temple of the Legends.
Reincarnation#031.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#032.src: Within, you will find a merchant who will offer you a weapon in exchange for it. I wish you luck with your future travels.
Reincarnation#032.speaker: Batelu
